_comment: Which leagues to watch and how loud. Every Fantrax call is a read; the league must be publicly viewable on Fantrax, because the bot runs with no login. To add a league later, copy the block in 'leagues' and fill in its leagueId, seasonId and your team's id.
_injuryScope: own = only your team; mine = your team and this round's opponent; league = every rostered player
